subject: Off-cycle expedited award request for Samir - critical migration response
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Off-cycle expedited award request for Samir - critical migration response

Team,

Quick ask — can we approve an off-cycle award for Samir Patel (Senior SWE on Edge infra) for his work over the weekend during the Acme Cloud migration incident? He led the mitigation, wrote the emergency rollback, and stayed through the customer replay with Acme engineering. The customer (John Doe) explicitly called out Samir in their follow-up.

Why now: payroll cut-off for off-cycle awards is next Friday (9/17). Samir is a top performer, and this was a one-off, high-impact event that materially avoided a multi-hour outage for a large customer. I propose a $7,500 spot award (one-time cash) and to consider a small equity refresh (0.03%) as retention protection — if we prefer only one, prioritize cash.

Attachments: migration_award_evidence.pdf (pdf) — timeline & logs; customer_thanks.txt — excerpt from customer email.

Budget: I have tentative budget from my GTM pool but need Finance code and comp/HR signoff. Please let me know what additional paperwork you need; I can provide manager justification and the Slack kudos thread.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Off-cycle expedited award request for Samir - critical migration response

Thanks Ben — appreciate the quick context. A few clarifying items so comp can evaluate: 1) Employment status (FTE vs contractor) and hire date; 2) Proposed award amount and whether you consider equity vs cash; 3) Any similar awards in the last 12 months (parity check); 4) Manager justification (1-2 paragraphs) that we can attach to the approval ticket.

Please fill out the off-cycle award form (link below) and paste the manager justification into the "Business Justification" field. If you need priority handling, note "payroll cutoff -> expedited" in the form.

Form: https://hr.redwood.com/forms/off-cycle-award

If this looks like a retention/ongoing performance issue we may want to consider a small equity refresh, but that typically adds 2 weeks to approvals. For immediate payroll processing, cash is faster.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Compensation & Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Off-cycle expedited award request for Samir - critical migration response

Hi Marissa — thanks. Answers below and pasted justification.

Employment status: FTE (hired 2020-08-12).
Recent awards: No cash/spot awards in the last 12 months. No equity top-ups in the last 18 months.
Proposed: $7,500 one-time cash (preferred) + consider small 0.03% equity refresh if Comp wants to pursue for retention. Cash is time-sensitive.

Manager justification (paste):
Samir led the triage and rollback plan during Acme Cloud's DB migration failure on 9/11-9/12. He coordinated cross-team runbooks, implemented a hotfix that prevented cross-tenant write corruption, and stayed on a 10-hour bridge with Acme engineers to validate recovery. The work materially reduced expected customer downtime and preserved the renewal timing for a $3.2M ARR account. Samir's technical leadership and calm under pressure were the primary factors in the successful mitigation. I recommend a cash spot award of $7,500 to recognize the immediate impact and a 0.03% equity refresh to reduce churn risk given competing offers we've heard about.

Customer excerpt (attached customer_thanks.txt):
"Wanted to call out Samir — that was clutch. He owned the situation and got us back to green. Appreciate the partnership." — John Doe, Acme Cloud

Payroll: Ben note — payroll off-cycle cutoff 09/17 EOD. Please confirm if comp can provisionally approve so Finance can lock GL (I can confirm budget cost center: GTM-NA-02).

Thanks,
Ben

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Off-cycle expedited award request for Samir - critical migration response

Ben — thanks for the details and the manager justification. Comp provisionally approves a $7,500 one-time spot award for Samir to be processed off-cycle. Equity refresh will require the standard committee review and will likely miss the payroll cutoff; recommend we proceed with cash now and start equity conversation in parallel.

Next steps for processing: 1) Ben to reply-all with final manager signoff language (one-line: "I approve this payment"); 2) Finance to confirm GL/Cost center and create the payroll ticket (PAY-4448); 3) Ben to attach final comms language to the HR form (we need to record the recognition message). Approval is valid until 09/20 EOD; after that comp will re-evaluate.

Mina Haddad
Director, Compensation
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Off-cycle expedited award request for Samir - critical migration response

Ben — confirmed we can process this off-cycle if we get the manager signoff and the GL. Please confirm cost center as GTM-NA-02 and provide the budget owner (your team code). We will create PAY-4448 and queue for next payroll run if submitted by EOD 09/17.

Checklist for Ben before I can push to payroll:
- Reply-all: "I approve this payment" (manager signoff)
- Complete HR off-cycle form and attach comms language
- Confirm cost center: GTM-NA-02 (please confirm)
- Confirm there are no outstanding termination/open offers affecting headcount status

Once I have the one-line approval and the HR form link, I will assign PAY-4448 and escalate.

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Payroll Operations
Redwood Inference
